caption: Figure 10.1: Measuring scattering, absorption, and extinction cross sections with FluxMonitor and TFSFSource. Left: a closed inner FluxMonitor box (abs_box) inside the total-field region integrates inward power to give σ_abs, while a closed outer FluxMonitor box (scat_box) in the scattered-field region integrates outward scattered power to give σ_sca. Right: temporal (Δt/2 phase factor) and spatial (averaging two bracketing H planes with dual-edge trapezoidal areas) synchronization of E(f) and H(f) ensures σ_abs = 0 for a lossless scatterer.
visual_intent:
Textbook-quality scientific schematic for a computational electromagnetics user manual. Flat vector style on a white background, high contrast, thin dark outlines, generous whitespace, sans-serif labels. Colour code used in every figure: primary grid G, total-field or forward-wave quantities in blue; dual grid G-tilde, scattered-field, backward-wave, or equivalent-current quantities in orange; exact/topological/reference items in dark grey; matched monitor surfaces and conserved-power items in green; truncation limits or unresolved features in red. Colourblind-safe. Every label must be spelled exactly as listed in this brief; mathematical symbols must be typeset correctly (hats, tildes, subscripts, transposes). Do not add any number, value, equation, software name, product name, logo, watermark or title that is not listed in this brief. Prefer fewer, larger labels over many small ones. No 3D photorealism, no cartoon characters, no hand-drawn or xkcd style.

Two panels (60% left, 40% right). LEFT PANEL: Nested Concentric Boxes in 2D/3D cutaway view. At the centre sits a shaded scatterer. Surrounding the scatterer is a closed green dashed 6-face box labelled 'abs_box (FluxMonitor in total field)' with outward normal arrows 'n̂' on all 6 faces and inward energy flow arrows yielding 'σ_abs = −abs_box.get_flux() / I_inc'. Outside abs_box is a blue box labelled 'TFSFSource' with incident plane-wave arrows 'E_inc(f), I_inc = |E_inc(f)|² / η₀'. Outside TFSFSource in the scattered-field region is a larger closed orange dashed 6-face box labelled 'scat_box (FluxMonitor in scattered field)' with outward normal arrows 'n̂' and outgoing scattered wave arrows yielding 'σ_sca = scat_box.get_flux() / I_inc'. At the bottom of the left panel: 'Φ(f) = Re ∬_S (E(f) × H*(f)) · dA' and 'σ_ext = σ_sca + σ_abs'. RIGHT PANEL: A staggered cell slice across one monitor plane S. A blue vertical plane holds tangential 'E(f)'; two orange parallel planes on either side hold tangential 'H(f)'. Curved orange arrows merge the two bracketing H planes onto the E plane with label 'averaging the two bracketing H planes + dual-edge trapezoidal areas' and a time-sync badge 'Δt/2 phase factor'. Bottom green check badge: 'lossless scatterer ⇒ σ_abs = 0 to discretization precision'.
